claim: The shown UTC date always produces the same solver-checked board.
sandbox: generate the same dated board twice; compare the full puzzle; count solutions

claim: A new UTC date changes the daily topology.
sandbox: generate consecutive dates and compare seed, endpoints, and channels

claim: All three sample boards can be solved through the daily-board handoff.
sandbox: fresh browser; solver-generated clicks; verify each end screen and the daily board

claim: The complete game is free and needs no account.
sandbox: finish all sample boards in a fresh browser without a form, login, or payment

claim: The complete game has no ads.
sandbox: finish all sample boards; reject ad surfaces, embedded frames, and requests to any other origin

claim: Three failed board tests reach a loss screen and allow a same-seed restart.
sandbox: fresh demo; fail three tests; assert loss dialog and same-seed restart

claim: An invalid placement leaves the board unchanged and the next valid relay works.
sandbox: fresh demo; choose a disconnected socket; verify zero relays; place a valid relay

claim: A hint explains a rule without placing a relay or naming a cell.
sandbox: fresh demo; compare paths before and after the hint; reject coordinates or directions

claim: Reset clears paths, moves, timer, and failed tests while preserving seed and sound.
sandbox: change every per-run field and sound; reset; verify exact cleared and preserved state

claim: Current paths, learn-board step, timer, and sound setting survive a browser reload.
sandbox: reach sample board 2; run the timer, place a relay, and enable sound; reload; verify every value remains visible

claim: With sound on, an accepted move produces audio feedback; with sound off, it stays silent.
sandbox: fresh demo; replace Web Audio with a recorded fixture; make accepted moves with sound on and off; compare audio starts

claim: Demo play uses separate storage; Reset demo deletes both demo keys, restores sample board 1, and leaves real data unchanged.
sandbox: preload real progress and settings; reach sample board 2 with demo sound on; reset; verify both demo keys are deleted, sample 1 is restored, and real data is unchanged

claim: Play data stays in this browser, and the game sets no tracking cookie or action request.
sandbox: allow same-origin static files to load; record demo actions; require no action requests and no cookies

claim: Tab reaches a socket; Space, arrow keys, and Enter operate the board.
sandbox: fresh demo; Tab from page entry to a source; select and place with Space; move with arrows; place with Enter

claim: Every signal color is paired with a visible letter and shape.
sandbox: open the five-signal daily board; verify distinct rendered colors and matching visible letters and shapes on endpoints and legend

claim: The board timer counts up from zero instead of counting down.
sandbox: fresh demo; observe zero, then a larger elapsed time while the board remains playable

claim: The demo label remains visible through every sample-board change and the daily-board handoff.
sandbox: complete all three sample boards; verify the demo label before each board and after opening the daily board

claim: The board works with touch input on a phone.
sandbox: fresh mobile touch context; tap a source and its next linked socket; verify the relay is placed

claim: Selecting an earlier relay steps the active path back to that relay.
sandbox: fresh demo; complete one signal path; select its previous relay; verify the exact shortened path and open signal

claim: Undo restores the state before the last valid action.
sandbox: fresh demo; select a source and place one relay; undo; verify only that relay placement is reversed

claim: Starting for real deletes demo data without copying it into real progress.
sandbox: preload real progress and settings; populate both demo keys; start for real; verify demo keys are deleted and real values are unchanged

claim: Clear saved game data deletes real and demo progress plus sound settings from this browser.
sandbox: fresh privacy page; seed all four real and demo storage keys; clear saved data; verify every seeded key is gone
